findings.text: Laundry and Swim (Virus Edit) share the credited composition team of youra, Car, the garden and U-Turn.
The laundry scene connects an ordinary errand with attachment to a remembered relationship; the water imagery in Swim can hold comfort and unease together.
youra has said that personal experience and the spoken sound of unfamiliar words both matter in her lyric writing.
Flicker and Dance extend the B side context; Motif introduces the later collaboration with Song Namhyun.
